teamUpAbilities.name: Gamma Boost
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Gain a brief defensive boost after using a gamma ability.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Doctor Strange channels the gamma surge, increasing the defensive boost and its duration.

teamUpAbilities.name: Radiation Slam
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Empower Hulk's next leap impact with bonus gamma damage.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Iron Man overloads the impact zone, adding a larger gamma blast and bonus damage.

teamUpAbilities.name: Metallic Fusion
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Charge the greatsword for a focused magnetic strike.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Chaos energy widens the strike and leaves a volatile magnetic field behind.

teamUpAbilities.name: Polar Shield
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Project a short-lived barrier toward the selected ally.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Luna stabilizes the barrier, increasing its strength and restoring health when it breaks.

teamUpAbilities.name: Mystic Maelstrom
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Release stored dark energy in a close-range mystic burst.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Magik opens a Limbo rift that extends the burst and slows enemies at its edge.

teamUpAbilities.name: Gamma Gateway
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Empower the next portal traversal with a brief movement bonus.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Hulk's gamma field fortifies allies passing through, granting temporary bonus health.

teamUpAbilities.name: Gamma Overdrive
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Temporarily increase repulsor damage after activating Armor Overdrive.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Hulk supplies gamma energy, further increasing repulsor damage and blast radius.

teamUpAbilities.name: Arc Barrage
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Launch a compact barrage of tracking micro-missiles.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Rocket Raccoon upgrades the payload, adding more missiles with improved tracking.

teamUpAbilities.name: Web Conductor
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Charge a web cluster that briefly binds the first target hit.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Peni electrifies the web cluster, chaining damage to a nearby enemy on impact.

teamUpAbilities.name: Amazing Combo
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Launch an enemy upward with a close-range web uppercut.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Squirrel Girl joins the combo, adding a bouncing acorn burst at the target's landing point.

teamUpAbilities.name: Limbo Charge
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Gain a brief speed increase after stepping through a Limbo portal.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Psylocke masks the exit, granting speed and a short window of concealment.

teamUpAbilities.name: Soulsword Link
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Empower the next Soulsword swing with additional reach.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Doctor Strange adds a mystic echo that repeats part of the swing's damage.

teamUpAbilities.name: Frozen Harmony
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Send a piercing ice note that heals allies and damages enemies.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Namor's tide carries the note farther and creates a healing splash at maximum range.

teamUpAbilities.name: Zero Beat
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Release a rhythmic frost pulse that slows nearby threats.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Iron Fist focuses the pulse, adding a brief burst of movement speed for nearby allies.

teamUpAbilities.name: Guardian Spores
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Place restorative spores on an ally for healing over time.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Groot nurtures the spores, increasing their duration and granting damage resistance.

teamUpAbilities.name: Celestial Focus
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Share a brief damage boost with the targeted ally.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Star-Lord synchronizes the link, improving the boost and refunding energy on eliminations.

teamUpAbilities.name: Ammo Overload
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Deploy an ammo device that improves reload speed for nearby allies.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Punisher calibrates the device, also increasing fire rate during its active window.

teamUpAbilities.name: Jetpack Tether
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Tether to a nearby ally and gain a short aerial boost.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Groot reinforces the tether, adding a protective shield while Rocket remains attached.
